description: Gzip size budgets for production Web build artifacts under static/. Initial baseline = measured gzip size * 1.10 (ceil). Tighten deliberately in follow-up tasks; do not raise budgets to hide regressions without justification.
baselineNote: Settings, locale, and IntelligenceSourcesPanel budgets use a combined production build after landing Daily Brief/Event Research, research API, and cost-attribution inventory changes (Refs #149 / #1131 / #1143 / #166 / #248); each rule retains its fixed headroom.
